verdict.rationale: Brex documents auto-enforced spend controls, per-transaction limits, and approval flows, plus an AI-powered expense assistant. An MCP server lets AI assistants review transactions, and webhooks send real-time event notifications, so a user could build AI-driven review themselves. None of the evidence states that Brex's AI automatically detects anomalous or out-of-policy transactions and flags them for review. Missing for 10: explicit AI anomaly or out-of-policy detection, an automatic flag-for-review workflow, documentation of how flagging works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
